# OligarchData — Technical Reference

## Overview
Each playthrough generates 4-6 unique billionaires with randomized personalities, ambitions, and quirks. They mirror the NPC Nature/Nurture model at the power level — immutable traits filter world events into behavioral decisions each cycle.

**Script:** `src/entities/OligarchData.gd`  
**Type:** Resource (class_name OligarchData)  
**Generated by:** `WorldDirector._generate_oligarchs()`

## Identity (Set at generation)
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `oligarch_name` | String | Random first + last name from pools of 12 each |
| `title` | String | CEO, Chairman, Director-General, etc. |
| `sector_of_influence` | String | Food, Tech, Security, Media, Pharma, or Energy |

## Intrinsic Traits (Nature — Immutable)
| Trait | Range | High | Low |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ruthlessness` | 0.0-1.0 | Will burn cities | Cautious |
| `vanity` | 0.0-1.0 | Obsessed with image | Indifferent |
| `paranoia_base` | 0.0-1.0 | Sees threats everywhere | Recklessly confident |
| `intelligence` | 0.0-1.0 | Brilliant strategist | Blundering |
| `greed` | 0.0-1.0 | Insatiable expansion | Content |
| `ideology` | 0.0-1.0 | True believer | Pure profit |

## Ambitions (1-2 per Oligarch)
Randomly assigned from pool. Drive autonomous actions each cycle:
- `Monopolize supply` — Acquire competitors, spike prices
- `Achieve political immortality` — Lobby Senate
- `Build a legacy` — Fund public works (vanity)
- `Escape` — Build escape route (paranoia-gated)
- `Crush the resistance` — Fund militia
- `Control the narrative` — Buy media outlets
- `Transcend humanity` — Fund augmentation programs
- `Purge The Sinks` — Mass displacement (high ruthlessness only)

## Behavioral AI (`process_world_state()`)
Each cycle, each living Oligarch evaluates world state and takes 0-N actions:
1. **Paranoia evolution:** `paranoia = paranoia_base * 30 + tension_factor + player_awareness_factor`
2. **Self-preservation:** If paranoia >60, increases security spending
3. **Vanity response:** If vanity >0.5 and public_image <-20, launches PR campaign
4. **Greed response:** If greed >0.6, raises prices in their sector
5. **Counter-player:** If intelligence >0.6 and player awareness >50, deploys investigators
6. **Ambition pursuit:** Executes ambition-specific actions

## Behavioral Profiles
| Profile | Conditions |
|---|---|
| Cornered Tyrant | paranoia >70, ruthlessness >0.7 |
| Panicking Coward | paranoia >70, ruthlessness <0.3 |
| Beloved Philanthropist | vanity >0.7, public_image >30 |
| Desperate Narcissist | vanity >0.7, public_image <-30 |
| Untouchable Mogul | greed >0.7, wealth >2M |
| True Believer | ideology >0.7 |
| Calculating Hunter | intelligence >0.7, player awareness >50 |
| Corporate Shark | Default |

## LLM Integration
`get_llm_context_string()` outputs: name, title, sector, profile, wealth, paranoia, image, ambitions, personality adjectives, quirks, and recent scandals.
